key_points: proposes the Transformer, based only on attention, without recurrence or convolution
encoder-decoder architecture with stacks of 6 layers
multi-head self-attention (8 heads) and scaled dot-product attention
sinusoidal positional encodings to give word order
28.4 BLEU on WMT 2014 English-to-German and 41.8 BLEU on English-to-French
trained much faster / at lower cost than previous models (8 P100 GPUs, 3.5 days for the big model)
BERT pre-trains deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text
multi-layer bidirectional Transformer encoder (BERT-base 110M, BERT-large 340M parameters)
masked language model: 15% of tokens are masked
pre-trained on BooksCorpus (800M words) and English Wikipedia (2,500M words)
fine-tuned with one extra output layer; state of the art results such as GLUE 80.5% and SQuAD v1.1 F1 93.2
LLaMA is a family of foundation language models from 7B to 65B parameters
trained only on publicly available data (mostly English CommonCrawl, 67%)
trained on up to 1.4T tokens; smaller models trained longer are cheaper at inference
architecture changes: pre-normalization with RMSNorm, SwiGLU activation, rotary positional embeddings
AdamW optimizer with a cosine learning rate schedule
LLaMA-13B outperforms GPT-3 (175B) on most benchmarks, LLaMA-65B is competitive with Chinchilla and PaLM
